name: M4 V69 A
description: The primary star of the eclipsing binary M4 V69, 0.7665 solar masses and 0.8655 solar radii; the two stars eclipse each other every 48.188 days.

radius.source: Primary radius (solar radii) 0.8655 +/- 0.0097, as DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164) lists it from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K)

mass.source: Primary mass (solar masses) 0.7665 +/- 0.0053, as DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164) lists it from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K)

temperature.source: Primary log Teff 3.784 +/- 0.009, as DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164) lists it from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K): 6081 K

gravity.source: Primary log g 4.444 +/- 0.132, as DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164) lists it from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K)

distance.source: Kaluzny et al. (2013), AJ 145, 43, the distance to M4 from V66 and V69: 1.82 +/- 0.04 kpc

text.card: The primary star of M4 V69, a pair that eclipse each other every 48.188 days.
text.introduction: It has 0.7665 solar masses and 0.8655 solar radii; its partner has 0.7278 and 0.8074, measured from the eclipses and the stars' motions.
text.locator: DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164), M4 V69: Mass, Radius and Period, from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K)

notes: Masses, radii and temperatures as DEBCat (Southworth 2015, ASPC 496, 164) (https://www.astro.keele.ac.uk/jkt/debcat/) lists them from Kaluzny et al. (2013AJ....145...43K).
SIMBAD knows it as [KTR2013] V69 (not Cl* NGC 6121 SAW V69, a different variable); it is Gaia DR3 6045461417425321984, G = 16.67 against DEBCat's V = 17.01.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6045461417425321984 (quality A), from 2013AJ....145...43K; Gaia DR3 measures none
